page.notes: Right page: cut off at its left edge; only the first letters of its lines are visible, so the column is given as fragments and the rest cannot be read. Doubtful readings: "aducrsatur" (printed letters unclear, read as adversatur); "quaeremoniam" (possibly quaerimoniam); "Ephræm" (the æ ligature is partly hidden in the scan). The marginal note "In monodia." is set in italic and stands beside the line with the reference mark "u". The reference mark in the text is read as "u" before "Nazianzenus".
